**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer).

- **Section 14.3 (p0668/p0671)** is the document's only liquidated-damages clause, and it runs in Ono's favour: on Array's breach or its concealment/falsification of material safety or efficacy data, Ono may elect to continue the Agreement, is relieved of its diligence obligations, and the royalty rate is reduced as liquidated damages. LDs payable by the counterparty to us are expressly compliant.
- **No Customer-payable penalty, minimum fee on termination, or early-termination fee** appears anywhere; Article XIV imposes only transition/wind-down obligations on Ono.
- **Section 7.1 (p0463)** late-payment interest (one-month LIBOR/interbank plus a margin, mutual) is a commercial interest rate, not a penalty for non-performance, so it is not a deviation under this rule.

This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
